entry.title: Entry #386 in X Corp v. OpenAI Inc, 4:25-cv-00914
entry.summary: ORDER: Before the Court is Plaintiffs' Motion to Voluntarily Dismiss Claims Against Defendant Apple Inc. ECF No. 385 . The Court finds that the Motion should be and hereby is GRANTED. Accordingly, it is ORDERED that Plaintiffs' claims against Defendant Apple Inc. are hereby DISMISSED. This Order shall not affect Plaintiffs' remaining claims against Defendants OpenAI Foundation (f/k/a OpenAI, Inc.), OpenAI, L.L.C., and OpenAI OpCo, LLC. Party Apple Inc terminated. (Ordered by Judge Mark Pittman on 9/14/2026) (saw) (Entered: 09/14/2026)
